# The double-read agreement, pooled — generated by `scripts/double_read_agreement.py`

*3 batch(es), 62 independently double-read keys.  Pooled raw agreement **56.5%**, pooled Cohen's kappa **+0.38**.  Between-batch variance (DerSimonian–Laird) tau² = 0.0721; the size at which one more ~23-key batch moves the pooled share by more than 5 points with under 5% probability is **n\* = 237** keys (PREDICTION.md's rule, recomputed from the batches so far) — NOT YET: 175 keys to go.*
